hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A permissionless Uniswap v4 hook that runs a per-pool token buyback after every swap, spending pooled secondary funds to purchase a designated main token. Spend is sized by fee and liquidity depth, paced by a time-bucketed rate limit, and gated on a time-weighted reference tick. An optional auto-compounding LP program can split harvested fees into compound, burn (via Glue Protocol), and recipient delivery legs.
